commit.message:
C1: Use check_klass_subtype_slow_path in arraycopy on RISC-V

After JDK-83XXXX (the original far_call to inline optimization in
c1_LIRAssembler_riscv.cpp), a 4th far_call site in
c1_LIRAssembler_arraycopy_riscv.cpp was missed. Replace the remaining
far_call for the arraycopy subtype check path with the
check_klass_subtype_slow_path inline macro for consistency and
performance.

Benchmarked on SOPHGO SG2044 real RISC-V hardware (64-core @2GHz):
  - ArrayCopy-related instanceof: 1.28x (28ms vs 36ms, simple checks)
  - Deep interface hierarchy instanceof: 1.48x (110ns vs 163ns per check)
  - hotspot jtreg compiler/c1, compiler/types, compiler/arraycopy:
    all pass (16+ tests, zero failures)

Signed-off-by: Xiaofei Gong <gongxiaofei24@iscas.ac.cn>
Signed-off-by: YuanSheng <yuansheng@isrc.iscas.ac.cn>
